description.narrative: The objectives of the Project are to improve solid waste management in Yerevan with investment comprising upgrading the existing dumpsite to a sanitary landfill; establishment proper landfill management; and building institutional capacity in the solid waste sector in Yerevan Corporate Development and Stakeholder Participation programmes. The Project will serve as a demonstration for the whole country and is expected to raise awareness of solid waste management issues.

Construction of new landfill

comment.narrative: The Progress Report No. 6 of the intervention covering period up to 30 December 2021 on page 5 states The tender evaluation process was partly delayed due to the absence of the PIU Support Consultants. The selection process of the PIU support consultant started in the beginning of 2019 and was finalised in October 2019. Without the support of the PIU support consultant it was not possible to complete the tender evaluation. The covid19 pandemic also delayed the evaluation process. Due to the lockdown announced in Armenia in midMarch 2020 the evaluation process fully stopped for about three months. After long processes the tender evaluation of first stage process is now completed and the second stage launched on 28 December 2022.Thus the actual construction work has not started yet as of the reporting period.
